title: 第5章 大王好人妻第6章 乌巢禅师美猴王经过黄风岭
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: “看来是天材地宝有着落了。”
叶云吩咐过老猴妖，除非搜集到一些天材地宝，否则没什么事情不要来打扰他修行。
现在对方过来，显然是任务完成了。
念及此，叶云身化清风，出了洞府，瞬间来到老猴妖面前。
后者顿时被吓了一跳，反应过来，看到叶云后，立刻恭敬行礼，“见过大王。”
“大王，按照您的吩咐，让群妖去各处黄风岭各处山头搜集天材地宝，如今已经有了一定的收获。”
叶云满意点头，“不错，让群妖带着搜集到的天材地宝来此，我自有奖励。”
老猴妖领命，正当他转身离去的时候，叶云叫住了他。
“老猴，你交友广泛，消息灵通，可知最近外界是否发生了什么大事？”
叶云询问此话的目的，是想看看有没有关于孙悟空的消息传出。
从对方身上推出如今西游处于哪个阶段。
老猴妖想了想道：“回大王，特别大的事情没有，只是据说西牛贺州有一妖王崛起，号称大力牛魔王，麾下百万妖怪，声势浩大。”
“哦？那牛魔王可曾婚配？”
“额，这我就不知道了，大王。”
老猴妖心思古怪，自家大王不去在意这大力牛魔王的实力，怎么反而关心是否婚配。
难道，大王对别人的夫人感兴趣？
叶云自然不知道在老猴妖心里，自己有了好人妻的爱好，他询问这个，主要是确定，牛魔王是否遇到了铁扇公主。
“按照铁扇公主的身份，如果和牛魔王成亲，肯定会大肆宣传，老猴妖肯定会知道。”
如今老猴妖对此不知，显然牛魔王怕是还没有结识铁扇公主。
由此可以推测，此时西游应该处于前期阶段。
“就是不知道是前期哪个阶段，是在猴哥学艺归来前，还是后……”
叶云心思浮动，准备等自己更强了，亲自去一趟东胜神州，到时候一看便知。
说起来，太白金星大佬留下的道统，也在东胜神州，届时也能顺便偿还因果。
脑海之中念头闪过，叶云随即让老猴妖下去召集群妖。
不多时。
群妖各自拿着自己找到的天材地宝过来。
有灵草，朱果，灵芝等等。
虽然不是那种极其稀罕的天材地宝，但胜在数量不少，也是一笔不菲的收获。
叶云挥手全都收下，然后释放出自己的一丝法力，注入黄风岭的湖泊之中。
因为他已是地仙中期，法力早已完成蜕变，带有灵性和力量，对于地仙之下的生灵来说，极其大补。
不过在场的妖怪们境界都不高，若是吸收他的法力，根本承受不住。
所以叶云只取一丝，并融入湖泊之中。
做完这些，只见叶云以清风刮起湖泊里的水，形成一阵风雨，落在群妖身上。
霎时间，这些妖怪本能的吸收，自身的境界在飞速提升着。
哪怕是老猴妖也获得颇多好处，比如年轻时受伤留下的后遗症，在不知不觉之中恢复如初。
“大王果然已入仙道，那天渡的就是成仙劫！”
老猴妖见多识广，立刻判断出叶云如今登入仙道，属于妖仙。
这令他心思震动不已，毕竟自己曾经在外界游历期间，见过不知道多少妖怪卡在这一层次。
content_en:
"It seems that the treasure of heaven and earth has been found."
Ye Yun had told the old monkey demon not to disturb his practice unless he collected some heavenly and earthly treasures.
Now that the other party is here, the mission is obviously completed.
Thinking of this, Ye Yun turned into a breeze, left the cave, and instantly came to the old monkey demon.
The latter was immediately startled, and when he saw Ye Yun, he immediately saluted respectfully and said, "I have met the king."
"Your Majesty, according to your instructions, I asked the demons to go to the mountains of Huangfengling to collect heavenly materials and earthly treasures. Now they have gained a certain amount."
Ye Yun nodded with satisfaction, "Yes, let the demons come here with the collected treasures, and I will have my own reward."
The old monkey demon took the order, and just as he turned to leave, Ye Yun stopped him.
"Old Monkey, you have many friends and are well-informed. Do you know if anything major has happened in the outside world recently?"
The purpose of Ye Yun's inquiry was to see if there was any news about Sun Wukong.
From the other party, we can deduce what stage Westward Journey is in now.
The old monkey demon thought for a while and said: "Back to your Majesty, there is nothing particularly big. It is just that it is said that a demon king has risen in Hezhou, Xiniu. He is known as the powerful Bull Demon King. He has millions of monsters under his command and is very powerful."
"Oh? Has the Bull Demon King ever been married?"
"Well, I don't know about that, Your Majesty."
The old monkey demon has a weird idea. His king doesn't care about the strength of this powerful bull demon, but he cares about getting married.
Could it be that the king is interested in someone else's wife?
Ye Yun naturally didn't know that in the old monkey demon's heart, he had a hobby of being a good wife. He asked this mainly to confirm whether the Bull Demon King had met Princess Iron Fan.
"According to Princess Iron Fan's status, if she gets married to the Bull Demon King, it will definitely be publicized, and the old monkey demon will definitely know about it."
Now the old monkey demon doesn't know about this, obviously the Bull Demon King is probably not acquainted with Princess Iron Fan yet.
It can be inferred from this that Journey to the West should be in the early stages at this time.
"I just don't know which stage it is in the early stage, before Brother Monkey returns from studying skills, or after..."
Ye Yun's mind was wandering, and he was planning to go to Dongsheng China in person when he became stronger, and he would know at a glance.
Speaking of which, the orthodoxy left by Taibaijinxing boss is also in Dongsheng Shenzhou, and he will be able to repay the cause and effect by the time.
Thoughts flashed through his mind, and Ye Yun immediately asked the old monkey demon to go down and gather the demons.
Not long after.
The group of monsters each came over with the treasures of heaven, materials and earth they found.
There are lingcao, red fruit, ganoderma and so on.
Although it is not an extremely rare treasure of heaven and earth, it is better because there are a lot of them, and it is also a huge gain.
Ye Yun waved and accepted them all, then released a bit of his magic power and injected it into the lake in Huangfengling.
Because he is already in the middle stage of the Earth Immortal, his magic power has already completed its transformation, with spirituality and strength, which is extremely beneficial to the creatures under the Earth Immortal.
However, the monsters present were not at a high level and would not be able to bear it if they absorbed his magic power.
So Ye Yun only took a trace and blended it into the lake.
After doing this, I saw Ye Yun blowing up the water in the lake with the breeze, forming a gust of wind and rain, which fell on the demons.
In an instant, these monsters absorb instinctively, and their own realm is rapidly improving.
Even the old monkey demon has gained a lot of benefits. For example, the sequelae of injuries suffered when he was young have recovered unknowingly.
"The king has indeed entered the immortal realm, and what he will undergo that day is the tribulation of becoming an immortal!"
The old monkey demon was well-informed and immediately judged that Ye Yun had now entered the immortal path and belonged to the demon immortal.
This shocked him. After all, he had seen countless monsters stuck at this level during his travels in the outside world.
title_en: Chapter 5 The King’s Good Wife Chapter 6 Zen Master Wuchao and the Monkey King Pass by Huangfengling
